fusions.name: Feeding Shot
fusions.desc: Strikes a target at or below 30% health for 18 damage, adding 1.5 times the remaining damage of every affliction on it, which are used up.

fusions.name: Taste of Blood
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health and deals 9 damage, makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Closing Circle
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Fresh Wake
fusions.desc: When you kill something, you heal for 20% of the damage you deal for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
